surfaces.part: parchment sheet with circular star chart disc

answer.evidence: The object is a flat wall-mounted chart seen face-on: a parchment panel (rows 4-26) with a dark blue circular star disc and wooden rods at the top (rows 1-3) and bottom (rows 27-29). The silhouette is 28-32 px wide with constant width for rows 5-25, and there is no horizontal top surface, no ellipse, no roof or edge-line band with eave shadow. The rods are 3-row front-facing strips with no top-surface evidence. The circle is a vertical face on the wall (the disc is a painted design). The whole piece is a vertical face, which is appropriate for a wall-mounted plaque or picture.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a framed celestial chart: a wood frame, a cream parchment border and a blue disc with star dots. Measured facts support it. It shows 16 visible tones per tile against 17 for the cheese stall and 20 for the roofed well, so it is close to the references. Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no flat fills. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted dark brown or blue and follows the adjacent material rather than a black sticker line. The frame has a highlight, mid and dark ramp, the parchment has some tonal variation, and the disc has several blue steps plus star dots. It is slightly flatter than the roofed well or the cheese stall, with about 5 steps against their 5-6, and the parchment area is a bit plain. Overall it would sit acceptably next to the references.
